claim: For every natural number n, the sum of the first n odd numbers is n squared.

lab_statement.name: odd_sum
lab_statement.lean: theorem odd_sum (n : ℕ) : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (2 * i + 1) = n ^ 2

independent_statement.lean: theorem odd_sum' : ∀ n : ℕ, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (2 * i + 1) = n ^ 2
